title: ActionForge Graph File (.act)
description: Schema for ActionForge .act graph files — YAML-based workflow definitions with nodes, data connections, and execution connections.

editor.description: Metadata about the editor that created/updated this file. Not used during execution.

created.description: Editor version when the file was created (e.g. "v1.26.5").

updated.description: Editor version when the file was last updated.

entry.description: Node ID of the graph's entry point. Must reference a node that implements the entry interface (e.g. core/start@v1 or core/gh-start@v1 for top-level graphs, or core/group-inputs@v1 for group sub-graphs).

nodes.description: Array of node definitions that make up the graph.

connections.description: Data-flow connections between node ports. Each connection links a source output port to a destination input port.

executions.description: Execution-flow connections between node ports. Each execution link defines the order in which nodes execute.

inputs.description: Graph-level input port definitions. Used in group sub-graphs to define the interface exposed to the parent graph.

outputs.description: Graph-level output port definitions. Used in group sub-graphs to define the interface exposed to the parent graph.

node.description: A single node in the graph.

id.description: Unique identifier for this node within the graph.

type.description: Node type identifier. Built-in nodes use the format "core/<name>@v<N>" (e.g. "core/start@v1", "core/run@v1"). GitHub Action nodes use "github.com/<owner>/<repo>@<ref>" (e.g. "github.com/actions/checkout@v4").

label.description: Optional display label shown in the graph editor.

settings.description: Visual settings for the graph editor.

folded.description: Whether the node is visually collapsed in the editor.

inputs.description: Input values for the node's input ports. Keys are port IDs. Array ports use bracket notation (e.g. "values[0]", "env[1]"). Values can be any type — strings, numbers, booleans, null, arrays, or objects — depending on the port's type definition.

outputs.description: Output port declarations. Used for array output ports that need to be pre-declared with bracket notation (e.g. "exec[0]": null, "exec[1]": null). Values are typically null.

comment.description: An optional comment or annotation for the node.

graph.description: Nested sub-graph for group nodes (type: core/group@v1). Contains a complete graph definition with its own nodes, connections, executions, inputs, and outputs.

nestedGraph.description: A nested graph definition used inside group nodes. Has the same structure as a top-level graph, with additional input/output interface definitions.

entry.description: Node ID of the sub-graph's entry point (typically a core/group-inputs@v1 node).

nodes.description: Array of node definitions within the sub-graph.

inputs.description: Input port definitions for the group interface, exposed to the parent graph.

outputs.description: Output port definitions for the group interface, exposed to the parent graph.

connection.description: A data-flow connection from a source node's output port to a destination node's input port.

isLoop.description: Marks this connection as a loop-back (i.e. the source is downstream of the destination). Self-referencing connections are valid.

execution.description: An execution-flow connection from a source node's execution output port to a destination node's execution input port. Defines the control-flow order of the graph.

src.description: Source node and execution output port (e.g. "exec", "exec-success", "exec-then").

dst.description: Destination node and execution input port (e.g. "exec").

isLoop.description: Marks this execution link as a loop-back.

portReference.description: A reference to a specific port on a specific node.

port.description: The port ID. May use bracket notation for array ports (e.g. "values[0]").

position.description: X/Y coordinates for the node's position in the graph editor.

dimensions.description: Width and height of the node in the graph editor. Primarily used for comment nodes.

portType.description: The data type of a port.

inputDefinition.description: Definition of an input port on a graph or group interface.

type.description: Data type of the port. Empty string indicates an execution port (used with exec: true).

index.description: Display order index of the port.

exec.description: If true, this is an execution port rather than a data port.

array.description: If true, this port accepts an array of values using bracket notation.

array_initial_count.description: Initial number of array elements to create in the editor.

hide_socket.description: If true, the port socket is hidden in the editor UI.

default.description: Default value used during execution if no connection or user value is provided.

initial.description: Initial value used by the editor to prefill the field. Has no effect during execution.

required.description: Whether this input must be provided.

options.description: Available options for ports of type "option".

multiline.description: For string-type ports: enables a multi-line text editor.

hint.description: Hint text displayed in the editor UI.

array_hints.description: Hint texts for individual array elements.

step.description: For number-type ports: the increment step for the editor.

outputDefinition.description: Definition of an output port on a graph or group interface.

type.description: Data type of the port. Empty string indicates an execution port (used with exec: true).

index.description: Display order index of the port.

exec.description: If true, this is an execution port rather than a data port.

array.description: If true, this port produces an array of values.

graphInfo.description: Metadata about the graph or sub-graph author and versioning.

contact.description: Contact information for the graph author.

inputOption.description: A selectable option for an input port of type "option".
